Updating my previous review.

Had recently travelled to Guhagar, but this time by their newly added AC Bus Service (Seater+Sleeper) to & fro. I must say buses are top notch, cleaned, tidy and spacious for sitting too. We had booked Sitting Seats and they were damn comfortable. I will anytime prefer this new Bus Service over typical Luxury Bus which are compact and uncomfortable for long journey with no leg space at all. What an upgrade to the service! Amazing! 😍

Only problem was suffocation after sometime because may be every passenger was adjusting AC flow to the lowest. AC temperature should be set once in order to maintain the Oxygen pressure inside. Additional blankets should be provided to Seating Tickets too.

I hope they will maintain this new fleet for coming years of services.

featured_reviews.name: Nirvan Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with SP Wheels, Virar while booking my Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450.

At the time of booking (20 Feb 2026), I was promised delivery by 19 March. However, today (22 March), they are saying they cannot confirm any delivery date. Now they are saying billing will happen by end of March, and after that delivery will take another 10–15 days. This is completely different from what was promised earlier.

The staff behavior is also not good. They do not answer calls properly and fail to provide clear or accurate information. There is no proper communication or transparency.

Even during my first visit, the staff seemed uninterested and were busy with their own work instead of attending customers. When I went again for booking, the situation was the same — no proper response and no interest in selling the bike.

Overall, this has been a very frustrating experience. I expected better service and professionalism from a Royal Enfield dealership, but this has been one of the worst customer service experiences.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves their service.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional 10-Day Turkey Trip with Pick Trip, Organized by Suhas Chopde

I recently had the pleasure of embarking on a 10-day trip to Turkey organized by Pick Trip and overseen by the incredible Suhas Chopde. I must say it was an absolutely amazing experience from start to finish! This review is a testament to the exceptional service, support, and outstanding planning provided by Mr. Suhas and the Pick Trip team.

Right from the initial planning stages, Mr. Suhas demonstrated his expertise and attention to detail. He meticulously crafted an itinerary that perfectly balanced exploration, cultural immersion, and relaxation, ensuring that every day was filled with memorable experiences. I was thoroughly impressed by the variety of destinations and activities included in the package.

Mr. Suhas's professionalism and dedication were evident throughout the trip. As our tour guide, he was incredibly knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely invested in making our journey unforgettable. His insights and historical context brought each destination to life, enhancing our understanding and appreciation of Turkey's rich heritage.

Furthermore, the accommodations arranged by Mr. Suhas and Pick Trip were top-notch. From luxurious hotels to charming boutique stays, we were consistently impressed by the quality and comfort provided. The selection of restaurants for our meals showcased the best of Turkish cuisine, offering a delightful culinary adventure at every turn.

What truly set Mr. Suhas and Pick Trip apart was their exceptional customer support. Mr. Suhas was always available to answer our questions, address concerns, and make adjustments to our itinerary when needed. His level of communication and responsiveness was outstanding, ensuring that we felt supported and cared for throughout the trip.

I highly recommend Pick Trip, organized by Suhas Chopde, to anyone planning a visit to Turkey. Mr. Suhas's meticulous planning, amazing experiences, and unwavering support create the perfect recipe for an unforgettable journey. Thanks to Mr. Suhas and Pick Trip, my time in Turkey was truly a trip of a lifetime.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

We appreciate your amazing review! It’s fantastic to know you were pleased with our service, Thank you for recommending us, and we can’t wait to assist you with your next trip!
